{{Quote|I used to have a heaping serving of skillet-cooked hash for breakfast every morning during my days as a brawler on Ord Mantell.|Dex's menu mentions his use of a skillet|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Skillets''' were cooking utensils used during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="DaD" />

The [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] ate skillet-cooked [["Besalisk's Bellyful" hash]] every morning during his time working as a [[Gladiator/Legends|brawler]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. He later served the dish in an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] called [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], which he owned in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district of the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Dex served the skillet-cooked dish<ref name="DaD" /> prior to the eatery's destruction in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TLOTJ:U">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Underworld]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Skillets were first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written by [[Gregory Walker]].<ref name="DaD" />
